name: Shattered Stars lengthens Starshatter's range by 10 yds (#2391)
contract: #2391: Shattered Stars 704771 reads 'Increases the range of Starshatter by 10 yds'. No 704771 reference exists in src/ because none is needed. Starfire Shot 801978 (family 32, flags 0x800, no shared bit) is the regression control.
